mentions.name: mruby-cbor
mentions.description: A CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) serialization library implemented as a C extension for mruby, built in an afternoon with assistance from Claude and approaching its official release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve written a CBOR implementation as a mruby c extension in an afternoon and am about to officially release it soon.

It’s my first project where I’ve worked with claude: https://github.com/Asmod4n/mruby-cbor
